subject: [hw] opus-venc: full host encode session passes (SEQ_HDR + IDR frame, ffmpeg-validated); fakevenc/ + facts/VENC_PROTOCOL.md
body:
Host only, no phone. The unmodified vpud + vendor libs now complete INIT -> SET_PARAM -> SEQ_HDR -> FRAME -> DEINIT against a fake VENC: seq-hdr 29 bytes (software SPS/PPS, Baseline CAVLC), frame 115812 bytes (I_PCM IDR from the model), run_vhost h264_check PASS (decode+PSNR); 640x480 too; ASan/UBSan build clean.
Reproduce (copies the tree to /tmp, applies the remaining patches to the COPY, runs):  bash gpu/hwcodec/fakevenc/run_session.sh   (last lines: "encode frame ... bytes=115812", "validated")
Unit: bash gpu/hwcodec/fakevenc/run_tests.sh -> N2TEST fakevenc PASS 3/3 (49 checks x ASan/O2/TSan; ffmpeg decode bit-exact vs source).
New files (mine): gpu/hwcodec/fakevenc/{n2venc_fake.c,.h,t_fakevenc.c,run_tests.sh,run_session.sh,apply_patches.py,STATUS.md,tools/wsites.py}, gpu/hwcodec/facts/VENC_PROTOCOL.md.
Key protocol facts (verified, details in VENC_PROTOCOL.md): every VENC register access is a GCE command (VCU_GCE_SET_CMD_FLUSH, 68 cmds per frame), never MMIO; offsets 0x000..0x12b0 only; buffer registers take pa>>4; start = W 0x058=4, done = GCE event 32 VENC_EOF (36 on core 1), size = 0x098 BYTE_CNT copied to DRAM by CMD_MEM_MV, ack W 0x060=4; RCPU microcode ucH264RCPUCode_AQ (0x8040 B) is memcpyd into an ion buffer whose pa>>4 goes to 0x08c; no POWER_ON IPI in GCE mode (kernel powers at flush). Remaining owner patches posted separately to IV/V34/V41/V40.
